title: Russian strikes on processing plants drive up Ukraine rapeseed export prices
summary: Rapeseed export prices in Ukraine rose by UAH 500-1,000 per tonne over the past week after Russian strikes on processing facilities disrupted oilseed processing operations.

title: Debris of Russian Gerbera-2 drone found in Moldova
summary: Debris from a Russian Gerbera-2-type drone was discovered near the village of Naslavcea in Moldova's Ocnița district.
